QUOTE: `app/actions/websocket/channel.ts:463` (`handleChannelDeletedEvent`) | If not viewable, kicks the user out if they are on that channel (`handleKickFromChannel` with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes them from the channel. If viewable, only sets `delete_at`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable the user is removed (and kicked out if on that channel), and when viewable the channel is kept with `delete_at` set (i.e., marked deleted).
